tagline.zh: 默认、未加修饰的 HTML:系统字体、黑白硬对比、1–2px 黑边框、浏览器默认链接蓝、零阴影零圆角——「诚实材料」的心态而非视觉配方。
tagline.en: Default, unstyled HTML as a style: system fonts, hard black/white contrast, 1–2px black borders, the browser default link blue, zero shadows and zero radius — a mindset of 'honest materials', not a visual recipe.

origin.zh: 源自战后建筑 béton brut(素混凝土),1952 年柯布西耶马赛公寓为建筑起点;2014 年 Pascal Deville 的 brutalistwebsites.com 将其「法典化」为独立数字风格——「对轻飘、乐观、讨好式现代网页设计的年轻代反叛」;David Bryant Copeland 宣言:「诚实材料:内容优先、链接像链接、性能即设计」(调研 03§5;补研 11§6)。
origin.en: Born from postwar béton brut architecture — Corbusier's Unité d'habitation (1952) as the architectural start; brutalistwebsites.com (Pascal Deville, 2014) codified it as a standalone digital style — 'a younger generation's rebellion against the light, optimistic, pleasing modern web'; David Bryant Copeland's manifesto: 'honest materials: content first, links look like links, performance is design' (research 03 §5; study 11 §6).

effect.zh: 实心黑边框宽度,经 --cb-border 驱动全部容器。调研 03§5 记载区间 1–2px,默认取上限 2px;对照新粗野主义的 2–4px 黑描边(本库 neo-brutalism 条目)——更细的边框是经典与 neo 的第一肉眼差异。
effect.en: Solid black border width, driving all containers via --cb-border. Research 03 §5 records a 1–2px range, default at the 2px top; compare neo-brutalism's 2–4px outlines (see our neo-brutalism entry) — the thinner border is the first visible split between classic and neo.

effect.zh: 链接色,默认即浏览器默认链接蓝 #0000EE(调研 03§5 逐字记载)。「链接像链接」:下划线永远保留,链接色就是浏览器默认色——不装饰、不品牌化,这正是「诚实材料」宣言的直接执行。
effect.en: Link color, defaulting to the browser default link blue #0000EE (verbatim from research 03 §5). 'Links look like links': underlines stay and the color stays the browser's own — undecorated, unbranded, the manifesto's 'honest materials' executed literally.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换 data-typeface)。system=系统默认衬线(Times New Roman 系,补研 11§6 判据「系统默认字体」);mono=等宽栈 ui-monospace/"JetBrains Mono"/Courier New(调研 03§5 记载)。两者都是经典粗野主义的合法字面——共同点是「不加载字体文件」。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-typeface). system = the system default serif (Times New Roman lineage; study 11 §6 criterion 'system default fonts'); mono = the monospace stack ui-monospace/"JetBrains Mono"/Courier New (research 03 §5). Both are legitimate classic-brutalist faces — the common point is loading no font files at all.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换 data-hover-invert)。on=hover 硬反色(黑↔白)零过渡(调研 03§5 记载);off=hover 仅补下划线,用于对照「反色不是唯一合法反馈」。无论哪档,transition 都保持 0——经典粗野主义不用缓动。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-hover-invert). on = hard hover inversion (black↔white) with zero transition (research 03 §5); off = hover adds only an underline, showing inversion is not the only legitimate feedback. Either way transitions stay at 0 — classic brutalism uses no easing.

note.zh: 零新特性依赖:系统字体、链接下划线、border、ul/table 全是 Web 元老特性,所有浏览器一致渲染;不存在任何 @supports 分支。
note.en: No modern-feature dependency: system fonts, link underlines, borders, ul/table are all Web-antique features rendered identically everywhere; there is no @supports branch to write.

fallback.zh: 该风格的 fallback 就是它自己:把 CSS 整个删掉,页面仍完全可读、可导航、可操作——「默认、未加修饰的 HTML」意味着浏览器默认渲染即是兜底。这也是它「性能即设计」宣言的来源:无字体下载、无图片装饰、无 JS 依赖。
fallback.en: This style's fallback is itself: delete all the CSS and the page remains fully readable, navigable and operable — 'default, unstyled HTML' means the browser's default rendering IS the fallback. That is where its 'performance is design' manifesto comes from: no font downloads, no decorative images, no JS dependency.

use.zh: 功能型内容站:文档、论坛、目录、新闻聚合——Craigslist/Hacker News 一脉的「常青用法」(调研:功能型粗野主义常青)
use.en: Functional content sites: docs, forums, directories, aggregators — the evergreen Craigslist/Hacker News lineage (research: functional brutalism endures)

use.zh: 宣言式作品集与杂志专题——用「反装饰」本身做表达,2014 画廊一脉的风格型用法
use.en: Manifesto portfolios and magazine features — anti-decoration as the message, the style-driven 2014 gallery lineage

use.zh: 原型与 MVP——零样式预算下用浏览器默认渲染先上线
use.en: Prototypes and MVPs — ship first on the browser's default rendering with a zero style budget

use.zh: 性能极限场景:弱网、低功耗设备——无字体/无装饰图片就是最快的首屏
use.en: Performance-critical contexts: slow networks, low-power devices — no fonts and no decorative images is the fastest first paint there is

avoid.zh: 消费级品牌站——「未抛光」与品牌信任感直接冲突
avoid.en: Consumer brand sites — 'unpolished' clashes directly with brand trust

avoid.zh: 数据可视化与富交互应用——黑白灰单色撑不起多维信息编码
avoid.en: Data visualization and rich apps — a black/white/gray palette cannot carry multi-dimensional encoding

avoid.zh: 把「风格型粗野」当长期皮肤:调研明示其易过时(2026-03 需求峰值 3.6% 后回落)
avoid.en: Treating style-driven brutalism as a long-term skin: research shows it dates fast (demand peaked at 3.6% in March 2026, then fell)

avoid.zh: 密集表单与支付流——默认渲染的控件外观在品牌一致性上会失守
avoid.en: Dense forms and checkout flows — default-styled controls leak brand consistency

a11y.zh: 黑白硬对比天然过线:黑字白底即 WCAG 对比上限 21:1,任何文字色核对都轻松过 SC 1.4.3。链接永远保留下划线(「链接像链接」=可及性线索不剥除);焦点环使用浏览器默认 outline、不去除——裸焦点环本身就是本风格的一部分。hover 反色不承载信息、纯装饰,键盘路径不依赖它。
a11y.en: Hard black/white contrast clears thresholds by construction: black on white is WCAG's 21:1 ceiling, so SC 1.4.3 passes without tuning. Links always keep their underline ('links look like links' = the affordance is never stripped); the focus ring is the browser's default outline, unremoved — the bare focus ring is part of the style. Hover inversion carries no information, it is pure decoration, and no keyboard path depends on it.

goal.zh: 复刻一页经典粗野主义站点:系统默认字体、黑白硬对比、1–2px 实心黑边框、浏览器默认链接蓝 + 下划线、零阴影零圆角零过渡,hover 硬反色——像 1990s 裸 HTML 被有意装裱。
goal.en: Replicate a classic-brutalist page: system default fonts, hard black/white contrast, 1–2px solid black borders, the browser default link blue with underlines, zero shadows/radius/transitions, hard hover inversion — a 1990s bare-HTML page framed on purpose.

acceptance.zh: 字体只用系统栈(衬线默认或等宽),不加载任何 web font
acceptance.en: Fonts come only from system stacks (default serif or monospace); no web font loads

acceptance.zh: border-radius: 0、box-shadow: none、transition: none 三件套全部成立
acceptance.en: border-radius: 0, box-shadow: none and transition: none all hold across the page

acceptance.zh: 链接为浏览器默认蓝 #0000EE 且保留下划线
acceptance.en: Links are the browser default blue #0000EE with underlines intact

acceptance.zh: 容器边框为 1–2px 实心黑,直角
acceptance.en: Containers use 1–2px solid black borders with square corners

acceptance.zh: 语义结构裸露:h1/p/a/ul/table 直接承载内容,删除 CSS 后页面仍完全可读
acceptance.en: Semantic structure is bare: h1/p/a/ul/table carry the content directly; the page stays fully readable with CSS removed
